traces for frontendservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 3.03->17.41ms (5.74x), errors 0.0923->0.1014; outbound calls slowed to 3 callees (adservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice): delay on frontendservice's own network

alternatives_rejected.why: A delay on frontend's own network would slow all callees about equally. Instead productcatalogservice inbound rose 97.7x (E2) while recommendationservice inbound rose only 2.28x (E3). Frontend's own self-time rose just 5.74x and its socket z of 17.8 is small (E4/E5), consistent with waiting on productcatalogservice calls.
Its own self-time rose only 1.78x (E3). Its latency-90 increase (E1) fits time inherited from its downstream calls to productcatalogservice, whose inbound path is 97.7x slower (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's pod network for injected latency (e.g., tc netem qdisc on its interface) and remove it. Then verify that inbound p50 returns to about 2ms and frontend error and latency clear. Restart the pod only if the delay cannot be removed in place, and get approval first because a restart is disruptive.
